violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION. CONSIDER HAVING ANOTHER EMPLOYEE OBTAIN CERTIFICATION.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED NO SIGNED COPIES ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS WILL EMAIL COPY TO PIC. PLEASE HAVE EMPLOYEES REVIEW AND SIGN, ENSURE SIGNED COPIES ARE MAINTAINED ON SITE FOR ALL EMPLOYEES AND AVAILABLE FOR REVIEW BY HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the MAIN KITCHEN AREA being used TO STORE DIRTY UTENSILS.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO TRANSFER UTENSILS TO 3 COMPARTMENT SINK FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink IN MAIN KITCHEN AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE ALL HANDWASH SINKS ARE PROPERLY SUPPLIED. ME LAND CHANTILLY (Inspection Date: 07/02/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Equipment food-contact surfaces/utensils were not observed cleaned before any possible contamination. DIRTY UTENSILS USED 4 DAYS PRIOR UNDER COUNTERS, ON EQUIPMENT AND IN HANDWASH SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE UTENSILS ARE WASHED, RINSED, SANITIZED AND ALLOWED TO AIR DRY AFTER USE AND NOT ALLOWED TO REMAIN DIRTY FOR DAYS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. CLEANING CHEMICALS STORED WITH SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS AND SNACKS ON AND UNDER COUNTER IN HALLWAY TO KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO RELOCATE CHEMICALS SEPARATELY FROM FOODS, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. BEVERAGES STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN BACK KITCHEN AND HALLWAY
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO ELEVATE FOODS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: COUNTERS WITH EQUIPMENT, UNDER COUNTERS, MICROWAVE, 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS AND WALLS in the KITCHEN, UNDER EQUIPMENT, UNDER 3 COMPARTMENT SINK, AROUD AND INCLUDING FLOOR DRAINS ARE in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS WILL EMAIL COPY TO PIC. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND POST FOR USE WHEN NECESSARY.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink being used TO STORE SOILED UTENSILS AND TRASH.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. CHEMICALS STORED ON RACK WITH SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS NEAR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK; CLEANING ITEMS STORED WITH FOOD AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS IN AREA OPPOSITE FRONT CASHIER ENTRANCE.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PLEASE SEPARATE FOOD AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS FROM CHEMICALS IN ALL STORAGE AREAS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED LARGE PUMP SPRAYER WITH CHEMICAL NEAR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PLEASE ENSURE ALL CHEMICALS REMOVED FROM ORIGINAL PACKAGING ARE PROPERLY LABELED. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PLEASE PROVIDE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SAUCES IN SQUEEZE BOTTLES NEAR HANDWASH SINK WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.
